unit.title: Graph Data Contracts and a Message-Passing Baseline
unit.scope: A bounded, self-contained software-engineering kickoff: implement and test a deterministic simple-graph core, classical traversal utilities, and one mean-aggregation message-passing step in Python.
prerequisites: Fundamental machine-learning concepts, including vectors and affine maps
learning_objectives: Turn graph assumptions into an explicit, validated data contract
Implement deterministic breadth-first search and connected components behind a small public API
Implement a dimension-checked mean message-passing step without a graph framework
Build reproducible unit tests for normal, boundary, and invalid inputs
Explain complexity, permutation equivariance, representation tradeoffs, and known limitations
required_evidence: Runnable Python source implementing the specified interfaces
Deterministic unittest suite covering the stated behavior and failure cases
Design note documenting invariants, complexity, choices, and limitations
Learner-authored comprehension responses tied to the implementation
